summary: Tianci International filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of a public offering on June 17, 2026. The company sold 4,055,000 units at $0.81 per unit and 2,000,000 pre-funded units at $0.809 per unit, raising approximately $4.9 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one share of common stock (or a pre-funded warrant exercisable at $0.001 per share) and one common warrant exercisable at $0.81 per share for three years. The offering is an equity capital raise with warrants attached; net proceeds will fund working capital. The pre-funded units reduce the effective per-share cost for investors. No advisor was named. The capital return structure is dilutive to existing shareholders with warrant overhang. What to watch: potential near-term dilution from warrant exercises and impact on stock price.
